authority: User: once the benching for this model is complete, do all future inference on the GPU instead of the CPU. Record GPU timings and ensure it is marked as GPU so it is not confused with CPU speed.
non_inference_cpu_work_allowed: data preparation and archive integrity checks
exact typed weight restore and artifact inventory/hash validation without model forward passes
training: Continue managed Tuldok CUDA training under existing source, custody and fit-budget requirements.

actions: Create a versioned CUDA implementation using the existing learned weights as the initial baseline; retain all complete-state stages and intermediate outputs.
Verify every model forward and learned stage executes on CUDA; fail explicitly on unavailable CUDA or unsupported operations.
Evaluate GPU outputs against the same registered native reference and accuracy metrics; CPU accuracy does not establish GPU accuracy.
Freeze the qualified GPU baseline before comparing new GPU model designs.
initial_gpu_qualification.precision: Preserve existing FP64 pressure and FP32 velocity/tracer semantics initially; disable automatic mixed precision and TF32 until separately qualified and explicitly labeled.

device_metadata: GPU model and device UUID when available
gpu_measurement_contract.timing: Warm up the exact configuration; synchronize CUDA before and after wall-time measurements. Use CUDA events for device elapsed time and wait for completion before reading results.
scopes: CUDA event elapsed time for the full device-resident generator block
synchronized end-to-end wall time, with input/output transfers and host preparation explicitly declared
report: amortized milliseconds per generated step = full block latency / K
repeat count and median, p95 and maximum observed latency
gpu_measurement_contract.comparisons: Compare relative GPU speed only under matched hardware, precision, input shape, timing scope and accuracy evaluation. Keep CPU measurements in separate labeled series.

accuracy: Recompute pressure-equation, pressure, velocity and tracer accuracy on actual GPU outputs; preserve existing worst-error thresholds, split discipline, every intermediate state and own-history evaluation.
historical_cpu_evidence: Preserve all completed CPU measurements and their original labels. GPU measurements neither replace them nor verify historical CPU latency targets.
target_interpretation: Future design iteration uses GPU accuracy and relative GPU speed. Do not infer CPU target attainment or invent a new GPU latency threshold from the historical CPU budgets.
future_fit_data: Use the authorized expanded training set for the next fitted model; preserve the 52 reserved scenes until successor freeze.
